_note: Expected seconds per phase of a user-initiated reboot, per product (/VERSION's PLATFORM) and kind. down: the request until the box stops answering; http: until lighttpd answers; ui: until occulited answers; ready: until rfd and hmipserver are up. A product not listed uses the one named by default. Read by occulited (go:embed) and by the web UI and the lighttpd waiting page at npm run build. Measured 2026-09-12 (three plain reboots per box, adjusted for the new boot order); rpi5 is a guess.
